questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: What is the dimensional formula for momentum?
questions.explanation: Momentum p = mv has dimensions of mass × velocity = M × LT⁻¹ = MLT⁻¹.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A body is thrown vertically upward with initial velocity 40 m/s. Maximum height reached is: (g = 10 m/s²)
questions.explanation: Using v² = u² - 2gh, at maximum height v = 0. 0 = 1600 - 2(10)h. h = 80 m.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Velocity is a vector quantity as it has both magnitude and direction. Others are scalar.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The ratio of kinetic energy to potential energy of a body at half the maximum height in projectile motion is:
questions.explanation: At half maximum height, KE = PE. So ratio KE:PE = 1:1.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A wire of length L and resistance R is cut into n equal parts and connected in parallel. The equivalent resistance is:
questions.explanation: Each part has resistance R/n. For n parts in parallel: 1/Rₑq = n/(R/n) = n²/R. Rₑq = R/n².

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the atomic number of Carbon?
questions.explanation: Carbon has 6 protons in its nucleus, so atomic number = 6.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What type of bond is present in NaCl?
questions.explanation: NaCl contains an ionic bond formed between Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the shape of NH₃ molecule?
questions.explanation: NH₃ has 4 electron pairs (3 bonding + 1 lone pair) forming trigonal pyramidal shape.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the hybridization of carbon in ethene (C₂H₄)?
questions.explanation: In C₂H₄, each carbon forms a double bond, using sp² hybridization.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If P(A) = 0.6 and P(B) = 0.4, and A and B are independent, what is P(A and B)?
questions.explanation: For independent events, P(A and B) = P(A) × P(B) = 0.6 × 0.4 = 0.24.

questions.question: Find the equation of the circle with center (2, 3) and radius 5.
questions.explanation: Circle equation: (x - h)² + (y - k)² = r². With center (2, 3) and r = 5: (x - 2)² + (y - 3)² = 25.
